key_points: Cathie Wood sold ~$37M of AMD shares, signaling possible short‑term skepticism.
Legacy Wealth Asset Management reduced its AMD holding, adding to modest selling pressure.
YHB Investment Advisors increased its AMD position, indicating some institutional confidence.
AMD CEO Lisa Su made bullish remarks while also warning of chip‑market headwinds.
Stock rebounded in premarket trading amid broader AI‑stock rally, though it fell 3.9% prior day.
